steps.title: Welcome to Developer Mode
steps.body: Let's build your first architecture in four quick steps. You can skip anytime.

steps.title: 1. Add a service
steps.body: Drag any service from the palette on the left onto the canvas. A Lambda or DynamoDB is a good start.

steps.title: 2. Connect two services
steps.body: Drag from a service's output port (right side) to another service's input port (left side) to wire them together.

steps.title: 3. Configure a node
steps.body: Click a node to select it, then change a value in the right panel — like throughput or capacity.

steps.title: 4. Run the simulation
steps.body: Press Run to send traffic through your design and watch where it flows and bottlenecks.

steps.title: You're ready
steps.body: Now pick a challenge from the panel and design it like a real system-design interview. Hints and milestones will guide you.
